column3: “No man” renders “not anyone”; “fail you” renders “abandon you.”
“courageous” renders “bold”; “give this people possession of” renders “cause this people to inherit.”
“make your way prosperous” renders “make your ways successful”; “have success” renders “be successful.”
“within three days” renders “in yet three days”; “provisions” renders “food.”
“in battle array” renders “arrayed for battle”; “valiant warriors” renders “mighty men of strength.”
“obeyed” renders “listened to”; “in all things” renders “according to all.”
